_: Copied to ~/.claude/polaris-memory/work-config.json on first use. It governs whether the polaris-work hooks speak at all, and where.
_askIn: Where the Stop hook may ask for a journal narrative. 'polaris' asks only in a project that has a .polaris/ directory, which is the default because a personal-productivity plugin firing in a client's repo or someone else's clone is a surprise. 'any' asks wherever you are. 'never' is the same as enabled:false for the ask but leaves the session-start backfill running.
_projects: An explicit allowlist of project paths, matched by prefix. When it is non-empty it wins over askIn: only these projects get the ask. Leave it empty to use askIn.
